instruction: In Geography_And_Magical_Realism.docx, capitalize the first letter of each word and bold the title line, then save.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly downloads the docx file and checks both instruction requirements: title case across all content paragraphs and bold on the title paragraph.
Title case check iterates all non-empty paragraphs and verifies the first alphabetic character of each word is uppercase — correct coverage for 'capitalize the first letter of each word'.
Bold check uses `run.bold is True` (explicit bold, not style-inherited), which is the correct approach for verifying a user formatting action on the title.
Metric correctly handles the `type: rule` expected parameter by directly accessing `expected.get('title_case_applied')` and `expected.get('title_bold')` — no wrapping/unwrapping error.
Postconfig sends Ctrl+S before evaluation ensuring the saved file state is read.
Negative control resistance is sound: the original document has lowercase words and no explicit bold, so the initial state fails both checks.
Partial credit scoring (0.5 per sub-goal) is appropriate for the two chained requirements.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor risk: the getter hard-codes `paras[0]` as the title paragraph. If the document starts with an empty paragraph or a non-title paragraph, the bold check would evaluate the wrong content. Consider skipping empty paragraphs when locating the title (e.g., find the first non-empty paragraph) to make the check more robust.
